The expanded point construction adds an ancillary answer to the original

### Description

Prove `consistencyDefect_convolution_eq_of_perfect`: addition-convolution with
an independent, normalized, perfectly correlated ancillary POVM pair preserves
the consistency defect exactly, so any defect bound transfers with the same
error. The state is the existing `vecTensor` followed by the explicit
`prodShuffle`, with four independently typed registers. The original state and
question distribution may be unnormalized, and the measurements need not be
projective.

The new module also proves complex and real expectation factorization under
this shuffle and the finite-fiber convolution identity, and is imported by
`MIPStarRE/QPBT.lean`. It uses effect families and existing placement APIs.

Statement integrity: these are generic auxiliary identities. The main lemma
assumes four POVM families, unit ancillary norm, and zero ancillary mismatch
mass at each question; its conclusion is equality of the actual consistency
defects. The ideal Pauli instance of ancillary perfection belongs to #267.
No source-labelled paper theorem is replaced or given an additional premise.

title: feat(QPBT/Observables): prove ideal point EPR consistency
body:
### Motivation
The proof of `lem:qld-comm-cons` uses perfect consistency of the ideal point
projectors on the two halves of the same EPR state. Issue #267 isolates this
ingredient from the tensor-transfer and encoding-support arguments. The source
is `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex`,
`eq:def-psihat`, `eq:qld-point-obs-def`, and the proof at line 489.

### Description
Add `Observables/IdealPointConsistency.lean` and its QPBT aggregate import.
Derive the real transpose and multiplication identities of the actual Pauli
projectors, using their existing completeness theorem and Mathlib's
`mul_eq_one_comm` for the Gram matrix. Orthogonality of distinct point fibers
and `epr_action_eq_of_transpose` then show that every off-diagonal joint effect
annihilates the EPR vector.

The public results give zero off-diagonal joint mass, unit diagonal mass using
`eprState_norm`, and zero `consistencyDefect` for any point distribution.
`tauPointMeas` packages the actual effects as a complete measurement; the existing
positivity and completeness proofs in `ExpandedDefs.lean` become public.

Statement integrity: the paper fixes a characteristic-two finite field, either
Pauli basis, an arbitrary point, and one actual EPR pair. Lean uses the existing
`AdmissibleParams`, `tauPointProj`, and `eprState` with exactly these quantifiers.
The conclusion is perfect ancillary consistency, with no original-strategy,
symmetry, or perfect-correlation hypothesis. Verdict: faithful boundary
hypotheses. These are Lean-only auxiliary results; no source theorem statement
or blueprint completion claim changes. There is no dependency on issue #266.
